selector_description: Crossed support by section x Davis hand and Currier-vs-hand permutation contrast.
exact_bound: No section+Davis-hand stratum contains both Currier A and B; HANDCURRIER_VS_HAND is exactly degenerate at zero. CURRIER_VS_HAND ratio=1.18 and does not resolve.
design_notes: Identifiability bound, not evidence that Currier has no descriptive effect.

selector_description: Frozen A3 explicit-codebook versus A4 no-codebook deletion across five physical-bifolium folds.
exact_bound: Frozen adequacy/deletion gate, not a post-hoc percentage threshold.
design_notes: Model-class-specific negative theorem: rejects the registered explicit preselected page-family codebook, not every conceivable page controller.

selector_description: E2 banded R64 versus E0 no reuse on lag2-5 exact-recurrence absolute error.
exact_bound: Primary gate passes 5/5 folds with effect/null-SD ratio 2.2348; banding over uniform also resolves at 2.2219.
design_notes: 50 paired forward generations/fold; identical generated family sequence across exact-token variants; no explicit page codebook.

selector_description: E2 lag2-64 banded versus E3 lag1-64 banded on joint lag1/lag2-5 error.
exact_bound: The metric does not resolve lag1 exclusion; the sign slightly favors allowing lag1 on mean joint error.
design_notes: This bound prevents the legacy refractory-window wording from being promoted as a necessary mechanism.

selector_description: Continuation-tail matched q-present incremental k/t prediction; primary ZLZI plus five alternate transcription layers.
exact_bound: Primary resolves; 4/5 alternate layers resolve positive; JSLI is positive but the metric does not resolve it; no resolved negative layer.
design_notes: Five balanced folio outer folds, four training-only inner folds, hierarchical shrinkage; exact continuation tail is in the baseline.

selector_description: i-run length incremental terminator prediction under preceding-1 and preceding-2 raw-character baselines across six transcription layers.
exact_bound: Both primary context bounds resolve; both bounds resolve in all 5 alternate layers; worst replay ratio across the reported layer/test grid is 3.5204.
design_notes: Five balanced folio outer folds, four training-only inner folds, hierarchical shrinkage; terminator classes frozen as n/r/l/m/d/$/other.

selector_description: Previous-token morphology child under six transcription layers with five whole-bifolium outer folds and training-only lambda selection.
exact_bound: Primary resolves; 4/5 alternate layers resolve positive; JSLI is positive but below ratio 2; no resolved negative layer.
design_notes: Morphology replay is independently reconstructed from the canonical corpus and folds.

selector_description: Nested exact previous-token child after the morphology parent across six transcription layers.
exact_bound: Frozen universal exact-closure decision fails; TTLI has a small positive resolved residual and only 2/5 folds switch the exact child off.
design_notes: This falsifies universal closure. It does not establish exact identity as a universal grammar layer.

selector_description: Frozen closure verdict plus strongest contradicting transcription layer.
exact_bound: The metric resolves a small TTLI residual, while the primary ZLZI exact increment itself does not resolve. Universal exact closure is therefore falsified; universal exact dependence is not established.
design_notes: Bound is deliberately asymmetric: it rejects complete closure without promoting exact identity as a general transition layer.

selector_description: Alphabetic EVA tokens; immediate previous+next glyph context with ^/$ boundaries; p/f/k/t family mean JSD; 100 nearest four-glyph controls by sorted log-frequency profile.
exact_bound: 0/100 nearest frequency-matched four-glyph sets were as context-compact as p/f/k/t.
design_notes: Exploratory post-hoc discovery. Frame-specific to current EVA-like representation; requires clean-room replay and alternate-representation audit.

selector_description: Tokens with exactly one k/t gallows and no p/f; collapse k/t->K; retain skeletons attested with both variants; leading q absent; compare paragraph pos=1 vs other within skeleton; balanced effective-sample weighting; skeleton sign-flip null.
exact_bound: Resolved whole-corpus q-absent effect; same direction and >=2 null SD in Currier B, hands 2/3, H-coded stratum.
design_notes: Paragraph position is available; physical line identifier is not. Do not interpret paragraph-first as line-first. Independent heldout replay remains open.

selector_description: Tokens with exactly one p/f gallows and no k/t; collapse p/f->P; retain skeletons attested with both variants; leading q absent; compare paragraph pos=1 vs other within skeleton; balanced effective-sample weighting; skeleton sign-flip null.
exact_bound: Resolved whole-corpus q-absent effect; Currier B independently remains >=2 null SD.
design_notes: Sparse f support makes this claim materially less secure than SGK18. Independent heldout and alternate-representation replay required.

selector_description: Exhaustive context-defined one-edit operators; discover on Herbal A/B; validate on Pharmaceutical-A vs Biological+Stars-B; require >=2 null SD and same polarity in both domains.
exact_bound: 21 operator classes clear the frozen >=2-SD gate in both non-overlapping domains with matching direction.
design_notes: Family sign-flip null; raw EVA/local edits. No semantic equivalence assumed. Full cross-transcription replay remains open.

selector_description: Connected components under externally portable operator libraries; exact type and hapax reduction reported as descriptive bounds.

source_snapshot.interpretation: Eight highest-coverage one-edit operators that first resolve in Herbal A/B and independently retain the same A/B polarity at >=2 null SD in Pharmaceutical-A versus Biological+Stars-B. Collapse is a formal family bound, not semantic equivalence.

Adds the separately established gallows substitution families k/t and p/f to the externally portable Currier operator library. Combined collapse is descriptive and bounded; the gallows selectors are local-state conditioned rather than admitted as Currier operators.

exact_bound: Conservative top8: 24.84% exact-type reduction and 23.14% hapax reduction. Top8+gallows: 33.14% exact-type reduction and 31.02% hapax reduction.
design_notes: Compression magnitude is not itself a significance test. Component membership is a formal surface-family relation only.

selector_description: Compare raw Currier A/B exact-token Jensen-Shannon divergence with conservative realization-family collapse; matched null preserves component-size distribution and randomly reassigns token types to components over 1,000 seeded permutations.
exact_bound: Top8 removes 0.05684 more A/B JSD than the mean size-matched random collapse: 14.17 null SD.
design_notes: This is evidence that validated operator families disproportionately encode A/B surface variation; it is not by itself proof of semantic identity.

selector_description: Within Currier+illustration strata, compare left/right neighbouring conservative-root distributions for paired variants in five strongest portable operator classes. Null matches one-edit controls on state, edit type, edit-position class and support within factor two; 1,000 seeded resamples.
exact_bound: Across the five strongest portable operators, paired variants are 9.45 null SD more externally context-similar than matched one-edit controls.
design_notes: Contextual equivalence is strongest for Xy/Xdy and pre-final d/e, modest for a/o, unresolved for internal e/o and internal o-before-d. Therefore do not promote a universal same-root rule.
